exposure: Type of ectopic pregnancy (cervical, interstitial, cesarean scar)
uterine artery methotrexate (MTX) infusion and embolization
Uterine artery methotrexate infusion and embolization combined with systemic methotrexate
finding: Combined uterine artery methotrexate infusion and embolization with systemic methotrexate was successful in treating non-tubal ectopic pregnancies in 96% of cases and appears to be safe with a high subsequent pregnancy rate.
